title: 5.2 Congruent Polygons

icans: I can identify corresponding parts of congruent figures.
I can use corresponding parts to find unknown values.
I can use the Third Angles Theorem.

vocab: a pair of sides or angles that have the same relative position in two ____________ figures
figures that have the same size and __________

blocks.p: Make two congruent triangles. Label them ABC and DEF so A matches D, B matches E, and C matches F.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Congruence statements: in △ABC ≅ △DEF, the order of the letters tells which parts _______________.

blocks.stem: △ABC ≅ △DEF. List all pairs of congruent corresponding parts.
△ABC ≅ △DEF. AB = 2x + 3 and DE = 11. m∠C = (5y + 10)° and m∠F = 60°. Find x and y.
In △PQR and △STU: ∠P ≅ ∠T, ∠Q ≅ ∠U, ∠R ≅ ∠S, P̅Q̅ ≅ T̅U̅, Q̅R̅ ≅ U̅S̅, R̅P̅ ≅ S̅T̅. Write a congruence statement.

notes: Third Angles Theorem: if two angles of one triangle are congruent to two angles of another triangle, then the third angles are _______________.

blocks.stem: In △ABC and △DEF, m∠A = m∠D = 45° and m∠B = m∠E = 70°. Find m∠C and m∠F. What can you conclude?
△JKL ≅ △XYZ. Which side corresponds to K̅L̅? Which angle corresponds to ∠L?

tickets.stem: Two angles of one triangle measure 50° and 60°, and so do two angles of another. What are the third angles?
Corresponding sides of congruent triangles measure 4x − 1 and 23. Find x.
